panel_description: FCS-10 canonical-food smoke (band gates + directional rank + golden regression)

gate_policy.per_food_band: actual FCS must fall in expected Mozaffarian 2021 band (encourage >= 70.0; limit <= 30.0; moderate in between)
gate_policy.directional_rank: min(FCS of encourage foods) > max(FCS of limit foods)
gate_policy.golden_regression: food_id=29 (Cheese, edam, mini wheel) must reproduce FCS=16.49 under the CNF 2026 edition

notes: FCS and FCS-10 literature validate aggregate metrics (Spearman r, RMSE, band accuracy) rather than publishing per-food canonical FCS values, so the smoke uses band-categorical gates (Mozaffarian 2021 Methods p. 8) rather than per-food numerical targets.

O'Hearn 2022 NHANES distribution: ~33% limit, ~67% moderate, ~0.5% encourage (the encourage band is exclusive in practice). Our smoke panel oversamples the encourage and limit bands for dynamic-range testing.

The golden regression at food_id=29 reproduces the CNF 2026 edition value (16.49) via the FCS-CODE-1 Mozaffarian rescaling formula; tighter pinning (+-0.01) lives in pytest at fcs_calculator/tests/test_fcs_rust.py.

rows.label: Apple, raw, with skin
rows.rationale: Whole fruit, no processing — Mozaffarian 2021 Fig 1 fruits have highest mean FCS among 12 NHANES food groups.

rows.label: Chia seeds, dried
rows.rationale: Seeds: high fibre + omega-3 + protein density.

rows.label: Milk, fluid, whole 3.25%
rows.rationale: Dairy beverage: protein + calcium offset moderate sat fat.

rows.label: Yogurt, Greek style, fat free, plain
rows.rationale: Plain fat-free Greek yogurt: high protein, calcium, no added sugar, fermented dairy. Rebaselined 2026-05-28 from retired CNF 502188 to CNF 6979 (same food, renumbered in the CNF 2026 edition). Lands at FCS 84.1, in the top decile of Mozaffarian 2021's NHANES distribution (only ~0.5%% of foods score >=70).

diagnostics.name: Yogurt, Greek style, fat free, plain

rows.label: Apple juice, canned/bottled
rows.rationale: 100% juice: no added sugar, some fruit nutrients but no fibre — Mozaffarian Discussion identifies juices as a borderline-moderate case.

rows.label: Bread, white, commercial
rows.rationale: Refined grain, high sodium — Mozaffarian 2021 Fig 1 places refined breads in the limit band.

rows.label: Pork, cured, bacon, raw
rows.rationale: Processed meat: high sodium, sat fat, nitrites.

rows.label: Fast foods, hot dog, plain
rows.rationale: Processed meat + refined bun: composite limit.

rows.label: Pizza, pepperoni, frozen, cooked
rows.rationale: Mixed processed dish: refined crust + processed meat + cheese; expect ~20-30 FCS (lower limit band).

rows.label: Sweets, sugars, granulated
rows.rationale: Pure refined sucrose — should hit limit floor (~1).
